Demo README.details: Synthetic network to test recommendations, friend graph, and private agent planning.
Ricky, Aditya, Arnav, Daniel remain the four main demo users in original sheets.
32 entirely fictional secondary demo users; no contact information.
288 fictional opinions linked to actual OSM place_id values in OSM All Columbus.
112 synthetic friend edges; some connect secondary personas to the main four.
Demo Private is a private-context fixture; enforce access control in the actual app.
OSM place existence, operating status and details require verification. Reviews are invented, not genuine customer reviews.
Import places and users first; then friendships, opinions, private context, availability.
Names and personas are fabricated; any accidental similarity is coincidental.
